detail.body:
## Overview Part 2 of #42449: `KVCacheSpec` now describes only a layer's **tensor layout**. **Allocation policy** (windows, recycling, prefix caching, Mamba modes) moves onto the KV cache manager that enforces it. Each manager declares its settings as a frozen `Params` dataclass; layers return `KVCacheLayerConfig(ManagerConfig(manager_cls, params), spec)`, and a group is simply *layers that share a block table*. **Draft:** CPU and GPU unit tests, plus E2E on GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; remaining E2E pending. ## The payoff: no more `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | Spec classes | 15 (8 encode only policy) | 5 layout classes: `AttentionSpec`, `MLAAttentionSpec`, `HiddenStateCacheSpec`, `MambaSpec`, `HiSparsePageSpec` | | Policy | spec fields + subclasses | `ManagerConfig(manager_cls, params)`, e.g. `SlidingWindowManager.config(sliding_window=w)` → `ManagerConfig(SlidingWindowManager, SlidingWindowManager.Params(sliding_window=w))` | | Spec → manager | global `KVCacheSpecRegistry` + platform hook | the layer names its manager: `SlidingWindowManager.layer_config(spec, sliding_window=w)` | | Mixed-layout groups | `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` wrapper | `group.kv_cache_specs[layer]` | | Cache-hit lookup batching | pairwise spec matching in each coordinator | `prefix_lookup_groups`: same manager config, block size, DCP sharding and layout | | Sizing | per-spec methods + wrapper aggregation | `manager_cls.max_blocks_per_request(manager_config, ...) × group.page_size_bytes` | | Backend builders | read policy off the spec | read what they need from their layers and `vllm_config` (e.g. `MambaBase.get_kv_cache_checkpoint_alignment()`, the layer's sliding window); no backend sees manager params | | `kv_cache_interface.py` | | +195 / −910 lines | Overall, non-test code changes 126 files, +2353 / −3244 lines. No compat shims: out-of-tree specs and platform-registered managers need updating. ## Behavior notes - Cache-hit lookups batch KV cache groups only when they share a manager config, block size, DCP sharding and layout, the same groups `main`'s core coordinator batches. Layout doesn't affect a lookup, but a batch takes the EAGLE last-block drop if any member does. The layout term (`_eagle_drop_layout_key`) can be removed once that drop is gone; #64096 extends lookahead block hashes, which replace it, to KV connectors. - The Mooncake store coordinator now uses the same rule, so unlike `main` it no longer batches packed groups whose first layers share a spec. ## Validation - `pre-commit run --from-ref --to-ref HEAD` and `pre-commit run mypy --all-files` pass. - GPU unit tests (1× B300), all pass: the worker suite below plus the Mamba/GDN/linear/ReplaySSM/KDA metadata-builder tests (594 passed, 27 skipped): ``` pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py \ tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_block_table.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_kpool_tail_slot_mapping.py \ tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_warmup_blocks.py tests/v1/worker/test_mamba_hybrid_model_state.py \ tests/v1/worker/test_mamba_utils.py tests/v1/worker/test_attn_utils.py tests/kernels/mamba/test_precopy_mamba_align.py ``` - CPU sweep (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=`) of `tests/v1/{core,kv_connector/unit,worker,attention,engine,simple_kv_offload,kv_offload}`, compared with the same sweep on the base: ``` pytest tests/v1/core tests/v1/kv_connector/unit tests/v1/worker tests/v1/attention tests/v1/engine \ tests/v1/simple_kv_offload tests/v1/kv_offload --timeout=120 --continue-on-collection-errors \ --ignore=tests/v1/core/test_scheduler_e2e.py --ignore=tests/v1/core/test_reset_prefix_cache_e2e.py ``` Every test that fails on the branch but not on the base fails for device reasons only (no CUDA, NCCL, world size, `vllm` CLI not on PATH); most of them are `test_mla_backends.py`, which the base snapshot could not even import. Two branch-only failures were real test bugs and are fixed. - Re-run on the latest commit: `tests/v1/core/{test_contiguous_kv_packing,test_kv_cache_utils,test_single_type_kv_cache_manager,test_prefix_caching}.py`, the Mooncake store worker/coordinator tests and `tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector` all pass (CPU; the offloading `test_worker.py` on 1× B300). The GPU worker tests `test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py`, `test_gpu_block_table.py`, `test_gpu_kpool_tail_slot_mapping.py` and `test_mamba_utils.py` pass (86) with the last commit's model-runner changes. - E2E accuracy with prefix caching, branch vs `main` (12 questions about a ~9.4K-token document; cold, warm-prefix-hit and batched runs). These runs predate the last commit's layout term and `block_table_width` method; the layout term only restores `main`'s lookup batching, and the block-table widths are unchanged. | Model / setup | Cached tokens on hit | Branch | `main` | |---|---|---|---| | GLM-5.3-Flash | 8704 | 34/36 | 34/36 | | GLM-5.3-Flash + MTP (3 tokens) | 8960 | 33/36 | 32/36 | | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4 | 13440 | 36/36, token-identical across runs | 36/36, token-identical across runs | | GLM-5.3-Flash P/D (NIXL, TP2 → TP2; 12 questions × 2 rounds; decode loads the prefill KV, ring buffer included) | | 23/24 | 22/24 | - **Pending:** E2E on hybrid SWA models, HiSparse and Mooncake.
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
